Now I can see the bug! In `readstat_copy_quoted`, when `this_len >= buf_len`, it sets `this_len = buf_len` (line 24), but then it writes up to `this_len` bytes plus a null terminator at `buf[this_len]` (line 45). This means it can write `buf_len + 1` bytes into a buffer of size `buf_len` — a classic off-by-one stack buffer overflow.
